reviews.shade: d'Alba [PINK CORRECTING] Waterfull Tone-Up Sun Cream Duo Set (50mL+50mL)
reviews.text: Love this tone-up sunscreen! The pink correcting effect helps brighten my skin naturally without looking too white. The texture is lightweight, blends easily, and feels comfortable throughout the day. It provides good sun protection and works well under makeup. Would definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款提亮防曬！粉紅色調整效果幫我自然提亮膚色，唔會睇落太白。質地輕盈，易推開，全日用落都好舒服。防曬效果都好好，用喺底妝下面都好好。一定會回購。

reviews.shade: d'Alba [PINK CORRECTING] Waterfull Tone-Up Sun Cream Duo Set (50mL+50mL)
reviews.text: Don’t buy it all these reviews on TikTok show something different when I tried it its just like a regular sunscreen no tone up no glow nothing i paid this amount of money for nothing so disappointed. I wish i can give zero stars
reviews.zh: 唔好買。TikTok 上面所有評價都顯示同我試嘅唔同。我試咗，就好似一般防曬咁，冇提亮、冇光澤、乜都冇。我畀咗咁多錢買嚟乜都冇，好失望。我真希望可以畀零粒星。

reviews.shade: d'Alba [PINK CORRECTING] Waterfull Tone-Up Sun Cream Duo Set (50mL+50mL)
reviews.text:
1. d’Alba Waterfull Tone-Up Sun Cream
- peachy pink color
- super hydrating and sticks to the skin well. 
Perfect for dry skin
- strong tone-up effect

2. espoir Water Splash Sun Cream Ceramide
- beige cloor (close to white)
- hydrates well, but after wearing it all day, feels slightly dry

3. Dr.G Green Mild Up Sun+
- white color
- least irritating and spreads smoothly, so it's stress-free to apply
- subtle tone-up
- moisturizes without feeling sticky. Perfect for inner dry skin
reviews.zh:
1. d'Alba Waterfull Tone-Up Sun Cream
- 蜜桃粉色
- 超保濕，貼膚力好。啱乾性皮膚用
- 提亮效果強

2. espoir Water Splash Sun Cream Ceramide
- 米色（接近白色）
- 保濕力好，但成日戴咗之後，會有少少乾

3. Dr.G Green Mild Up Sun+
- 白色
- 最唔易刺激，推開好順滑，所以塗抹好輕鬆
- 微微提亮
- 保濕但唔會黏。啱內乾肌用

reviews.shade: d'Alba Waterfull Tone Up Sun Cream Duo (50mL + 50mL)
reviews.text:
I knocked off a star because of the scent, it has a citrus scent its not super overpowering, but it's not subtle either.
The performance of this product is not bad it takes some time to fully blend and absorb in its not as seamless as some other sunscreens I've used. Keeping in mind it is a TONE UP, but in my opinion if you're anything DARKER THAN fair/ light skintone NC20-30 or kr skintone 21&23 I would not recommend this because YOU WILL LOOK ASHY please be aware.
reviews.zh:
我扣咗一粒星，因為香味。佢有柑橘香，但唔算好濃，又唔算好淡。
呢款產品表現唔差，但需要一段時間先完全推開同吸收，唔及我用過嘅一啲防曬咁順滑。要記住，呢款係提亮產品。不過我嘅睇法係，如果你嘅膚色比 fair／light（NC20-30）或者韓國膚色 21 同 23 深嘅話，我唔建議你用，因為你會變得好灰（ASHY），請留意。

reviews.text:
Umm… unfotunately, not really my tone.. 😞
A few yrs ago, I tried a brand of tone-up one, and I didnt like it. Since then, I’ve used no-color ones. Then, Everybody was praising about this Dalba one, so I gave it a try… and again… nahhh….;;; someway somehow the pink tone-up of Dalba’s didn't work for me.
Or My skin tone is just not for the simple tone up sunscreens… lol 
And the texture of Dalba’s is too creamy for me. I personally prefer light cream/gel texture to creamy one..
It would be a good tone-up one for others, just didnt work for me…
reviews.zh:
嗯……好可惜，唔太啱我嘅色調。😞
幾年前，我試過一個牌子嘅提亮防曬，但唔鍾意。從嗰時開始，我一直用無色嗰類。然後大家都讚呢款 Dalba，所以我試吓……但係……唔行……；;; 唔知點解，Dalba 嘅粉紅色提亮效果對我冇效。
或者係我嘅膚色唔啱普通提亮防曬……哈哈
而且 Dalba 嘅質地對我嚟講太厚身，我個人偏好輕盈嘅乳霜或者啫喱質地，多過濃厚嘅。
對其他人嚟講，佢可能係一款好嘅提亮防曬，只係對我唔啱……

reviews.text: Pretty glossy tone up that’s not too pink. You can build up the brightness if you want by layering, but one application looks natural even on olive skin. It’s very lightweight but not drying and it has a fresh citrus smell. It’s never irritated my skin. It’s best for dry to dehydrated/combo skin~
reviews.zh: 好有光澤嘅提亮防曬，唔會太粉。如果想更提亮，可以疊加，但係只塗一次，即使係橄欖膚色都睇落好自然。質地好輕，但唔乾，而且有清新嘅柑橘香味。從來冇刺激過我嘅皮膚。最啱乾性至缺水肌、混合肌用～

reviews.shade: d'Alba [PINK CORRECTING] Waterfull Tone-Up Sun Cream Duo Set (50mL+50mL)
reviews.text: Nice tone up sun cream. I like this a bit more than the Espoir one as this one didn’t irritate my reactive skin. Also the other one was so heavily perfumed. Love the tone up effect as it doubles as a makeup base and brightens my tired, dull skin. I would have preferred this to have been sold as a single though, as I wouldn’t use it up that quickly compared to a regular chemical sun cream. I would also highly recommend the essence sun cream from d’Alba when I don’t want the tone up. It is amazing.
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅提亮防曬。我比 Espoir 嗰款更鍾意呢款，因為呢款冇刺激我嘅易敏感肌。而且嗰款香味太重。我好鍾意提亮效果，因為佢可以當作妝前底霜，令我疲倦、暗啞嘅皮膚都亮返啲。不過，我本來更希望呢款可以單獨出售，因為比起一般化學防曬霜，我唔會咁快用晒。如果我唔想要提亮效果，我都好推薦 d'Alba 嘅精華防曬霜。佢真係好好。

reviews.shade: d'Alba [PINK CORRECTING] Waterfull Tone-Up Sun Cream Duo Set (50mL+50mL)
reviews.text: If you have a neutral or slightly olive skin, it will make your face be quite 'pink' compared to your neck. My skin tone is neutral light, but it still makes me look very unnatural. Color-wise, I wish they could diversify for different skin colors. Other than that, the sunscreen works great, and applies smoothly and blends into my skin very easily.
reviews.zh: 如果你膚色係中性或者微橄欖色，佢會令你面睇落同頸比較「粉紅」。我嘅膚色係中性淺色，但佢都令我睇落好唔自然。顏色方面，我希望佢哋可以為唔同膚色設計更多選擇。除此之外，防曬效果好好，塗抹順滑，而且好易融入皮膚。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
